title: Scaling RNA Foundation Models through Iterative Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2610.13106v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Biological function in RNA is encoded across scales, from local sequence motifs to long-range structural dependencies. Conventional RNA foundation models couple parameter capacity and inference depth within a fixed architecture, prescribing a fixed computation graph for each inference. Here we present Eco-RNA, an 80M-parameter RNA foundation model that makes inference depth adjustable through learned iterative refinement. Its shared, input-conditioned Transformer core refines sequence representations through repeated application. The iteration count is selected after training and controls effective depth at fixed model parameters. We train across recurrent depths with masked reconstruction, state regularization, and a one-sided loss that anchors deeper reconstruction to a shallow reference. On the 70-assay RNAGym fitness benchmark, increasing refinement from one to four iterations raises aggregate absolute Spearman correlation from 0.242

translated_title: 通过迭代精化扩展RNA基础模型
translated_abstract: RNA中的生物功能在多个尺度上进行编码，从局部序列基序到长程结构依赖关系。传统的RNA基础模型在固定架构中将参数容量与推理深度耦合在一起，为每次推理规定固定的计算图。在此，我们提出了Eco-RNA，一个8000万参数的RNA基础模型，它通过学习式迭代精化使推理深度可调。其共享的、输入条件化的Transformer核心通过反复应用来精化序列表示。迭代次数在训练完成后选定，并在模型参数固定的情况下控制有效深度。我们在不同循环深度上进行训练，采用掩码重建、状态正则化，以及一种将更深重建锚定于浅层参考的单侧损失。在包含70项测定的RNAGym适应性基准测试中，将精化迭代从一次增加到四次，使总体绝对Spearman相关系数从0.242得到提升（摘要此处原文截断）。
tldr: Eco-RNA是一个8000万参数的RNA基础模型，通过学习式迭代精化使推理深度可调，在固定参数下增加迭代次数即可显著提升RNA适应性预测性能。
en_tdlr: Eco-RNA is an 80M-parameter RNA foundation model that enables adjustable inference depth through learned iterative refinement, improving RNA fitness prediction by simply increasing the number of refinement iterations at fixed model parameters.
